description: Airport TAF forecast decoded — Decoded NOAA TAF terminal aerodrome forecasts for 1-5 airports (ids=KJFK,KORD; 3-letter US codes get K). Each forecast period with wind/gusts, visibility, weather, ceiling and VFR/MVFR/IFR/LIFR flight category, plus current category, worst in next 6h, hazard flags (gusts, thunderstorms, snow/ice, wind shear) and a one-line summary. Public-domain NOAA Aviation Weather Center data. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_taf
